name: Snake Strike
body:
You can move in quickly to strike, catching your opponent off guard, using your momentum to trip him up.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Feint, Base attack bonus +6

Benefit: You can make a Bluff check to feint in combat as a swift action.

Normal: Feinting in combat is a standard action.
